I first got into it during my GCSE's (English exams at age 15-16ish) when I wanted to make art toys, but couldn't afford to buy silicone molding supplies. I came across a picture of a box with a face on it and figured "I could do that". I made a bunch of toys for my art GCSE and really enjoyed it, I was always designing characters and monsters as a kid, and now I could hold them and put them on a shelf.

I just kept doing it for 6ish years after that, until now where I do it full time for a company and continue on personal projects/commissions after work.
